# openvidstudio

> Code-based video generation. An open-source video pipeline for AI coding agents: a real browser captures your real product, and the agent plans, narrates, scores and renders the video locally, through MCP tools. Every frame of your product is a real capture, never a generated mockup.

openvidstudio is a Node project maintained at
[github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio) under the
Apache-2.0 license. openvidstudio's own code is free for everyone, including companies of any
size. It renders through Remotion, which is free for individuals, non-profits, evaluation use and
for-profit companies with up to 3 employees; a larger company needs a separate Remotion Company
License ([remotion.pro](https://www.remotion.pro/license)) to render with it. See the README's
License section.

Install in Claude Code (and the Claude desktop Code tab and Cowork) with the plugin: `/plugin marketplace add
AnayDhawan/openvidstudio`, then `/plugin install openvidstudio@openvidstudio`. For any other MCP client add
`npx -y @openvidstudio/mcp-server` to its config (command `npx`, args `-y` and `@openvidstudio/mcp-server`); the
release after 1.3.1 adds `npx -y @openvidstudio/mcp-server install claude-desktop` (or `cursor`, `vscode`) to write that
config for you. To run from source instead, clone the repo, `pnpm install`, `pnpm build`, then point the client at
`packages/mcp-server/dist/stdio.js`.

This file follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention: a short, stable,
plain-language map of the project for language models and the people using them. Keep it
current when the links below move, and keep it short: it is an index, not documentation.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/README.md): what this is, why
  it exists, and how to install and run it.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed
  in each release, newest first.
- [TOOLS](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/TOOLS.md): every
  MCP tool with a one-line purpose, generated from the server's own registry.
- [CREATIVE](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/CREATIVE.md): the
  craft of directing a video: story, hook, motif, copy, pacing to music, camera, review rubric.
- [PIPELINE](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/PIPELINE.md) and
  [API](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/API.md): the order of
  work, and every `@openvidstudio/core` primitive with a rendered still.
- [PLANNING](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/PLANNING.md): the
  intake flow an agent follows before it writes or renders anything.

## Contributing

- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup,
  where things live, how to run the tests, and what a good pull request looks like.
- [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [Good first issues](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/labels/good%20first%20issue)

## Supernova mode

- [SUPERNOVA.md](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/packages/docs/SUPERNOVA.md): short animated
  STEM lessons (one concept, up to two minutes, 1080x1920, narrated, the same seven-beat arc every time). Made with `init_project` `mode: "supernova"`, the
  `@openvidstudio/stem` primitives, `check_script` and word-timed narration. The pieces work and are tested; no finished
  lesson has been published yet.

## Security

- [Security policy](https://github.com/AnayDhawan/openvidstudio/blob/main/SECURITY.md): report
  vulnerabilities privately to dhawansanay@gmail.com, not as a public issue.
